job.title: Junior AI/ML Engineer (PyTorch & NLP)
job.description: BhashaAI is a Bengaluru research lab building generative AI models for Indian languages. We are hiring a Junior ML Engineer proficient in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, fine-tuning LLMs, and tokenization. Candidates must understand evaluation metrics like BLEU and ROUGE.

pool.text: PyTorch & Transformers: implemented and fine-tuned Transformer-based sequence classification models
Hugging Face ecosystem: proficient with datasets, tokenizers, accelerate, and PEFT / LoRA fine-tuning
Data Preprocessing for NLP: cleaned multilingual text datasets with regex, deduplication, and normalizers
Evaluation Metrics: evaluated language models using BLEU, ROUGE, Perplexity, and F1 score
IndicSummarizer: fine-tuned mT5 model on Hindi news dataset achieving 34.2 ROUGE-L score
B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, IIT Madras, 2022–2026, CGPA 8.8/10
Experiment Tracking with Weights & Biases: logged loss curves, hyperparameter sweeps, and model artifacts
WordPress development: managed blogs using Elementor drag-and-drop builder
ML Research Intern at BhashaTech (Bengaluru, 5 months): trained IndicBERT embeddings for classification
Python & NumPy / Pandas: vectorized mathematical computations and tabular data wrangling
React frontend: built a calculator using Tailwind CSS
GPU Acceleration: utilized CUDA, mixed-precision training (FP16/BF16), and memory profiling
